scope: Startup, optional browser signals, effect cleanup and retained preview media. Renderer, source pixels, clock and weather algorithms were not modified by these fixes; application lifecycle infrastructure was modified.

baseline_reproductions.method: Executed each original hook's actual TypeScript-stripped effect body with stubbed React hooks and browser objects; no duplicate hook implementation and no browser used.

conditions.media_query: matches plus addListener/removeListener only; modern addEventListener/removeEventListener absent

baseline_reproductions.limits: Injected legacy API shape, not a claim that a specific physical browser was tested. The throwing effect never returned its cleanup, leaving the already registered observer and resize listener.

baseline_reproductions.method: Imported and executed the original retainPoeticBootstrap function with an initially playing mock HTMLVideoElement and entry group; no mirrored implementation and no browser used.
baseline_reproductions.conditions: Parser cleanup is registered; video starts paused=false; group.getAnimations returns an empty list; retain runs, then React rendering fails before attachPoeticBootstrap can run.

source.role: Fallback restores copied HTML without releasing the retained original

baseline_reproductions.limits: The mock proves the missing pause/release lifecycle operation and retained references. It does not measure a real decoder or CPU usage. Browser fault-injection regression is recorded separately.

source.role: Snapshots root.innerHTML after the earlier parser has assigned video.src
Recreates that markup after render failure

follow_on_source_finding.condition: Static bootstrap video has autoplay and preload=auto; parser has assigned src before main captures fallbackHtml.
follow_on_source_finding.assessment: Releasing the original retained video alone leaves a new autoplay-capable video in copied fallback HTML. This was a source finding, not an additional original-browser reproduction.
follow_on_source_finding.fix: snapshotStaticFallback copies trusted current markup into an inert template, removes video/source src and video autoplay, selects preload=none and disables copied entry animation/preview. The live parser video and its source phase are untouched.

post_fix_actual_module_checks.size_hooks: Both actual hooks return cleanup with legacy media queries, disconnect one observer and leave zero resize listeners after cleanup.
post_fix_actual_module_checks.persistent_regression_ownership: scripts/tests/test_browser_signals.mjs and scripts/qa/verify_audit_hardening.py contain independently maintained regression coverage. See their actual results for final-browser claims.
